title: How to Build a Referral Program in 2026 (+80 Examples) — ReferralCandy

facts.fact: The vendor ReferralCandy states that non-cash perks convert about 25% better than cash payouts, a claim the page does not source to a study.
facts.quote: Non-cash perks convert about 25% better than cash payouts

facts.fact: ReferralCandy offers a 7-day free trial that requires no credit card.
The article presents a collection of more than 80 referral program examples, including brands such as Tesla and Airbnb.
facts.quote: Browse 80 + referral program examples from Tesla to Airbnb

facts.fact: The page says referral program categories in its examples include e-commerce, SaaS, subscription boxes, and services.
facts.quote: Categories include e-commerce, SaaS, subscription boxes, and services
